$comment: MCP server registration. Invokes the bundled mcp/index.js directly via node, using Claude Code's ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} substitution so the path resolves to wherever the plugin is installed (not CWD-dependent). No PATH lookup, no `npm link` step, no `npx` registry hit. The bundle is regenerated by `bun run build:mcp` (which writes here and to packages/mcp/dist/mcp.js). Port is auto-discovered from ~/.claude/live-feedback/server.json.
